obligations.summary: CE marking for high-risk AI systems must be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.
For high-risk AI systems provided digitally, a digital CE marking must be used, accessible via the interface or via an easily accessible machine-readable code or other electronic means.
exceptions: Digital CE marking is only required if it can easily be accessed via the interface or machine-readable code

obligations.summary: The CE marking must be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly on high-risk AI systems, or on packaging or accompanying documentation where affixing directly is not possible or not warranted.
exceptions: Where affixing directly to the system is not possible or not warranted due to the nature of the system, it may be affixed to the packaging or accompanying documentation

obligations.summary: Where applicable, the CE marking must be followed by the identification number of the notified body responsible for the conformity assessment, and that number must also appear in any promotional material claiming CE marking compliance.
exceptions: Identification number requirement applies only where a notified body is involved in the conformity assessment procedure under Article 43

obligations.summary: Where high-risk AI systems are subject to other Union law also requiring CE marking, the CE marking must indicate that the system also fulfils the requirements of that other law.
exceptions: Applies only where other applicable Union law also provides for CE marking
